_comment: Sound cue catalogue (9 Nov 2026), read by scripts/core/sound.gd. cues: id -> file, bus (default_bus_layout.tres), volume_db, loop (the file's .import loop_mode must match), distance (unit_size / max_distance in metres), source, licence. bindings: scripts whose signals play cues; objects stay silent themselves. Record: docs/guides/TOWN_DESIGN_BRIEF.md 'Bathroom fixtures'.

toilet.flush.licence: CC0 (Freesound); trimmed to 2.8 s with a fade-out, 16-bit mono

faucet.run.licence: CC0 (Freesound); steady 3.2-10.2 s made a 6.5 s crossfaded loop, 16-bit mono

siren.fire_truck.source: Synthesised for this game (21 Nov 2026): low wail 400-1000 Hz, 5 s cycle
siren.fire_truck.licence: Original, no third-party material; 22.05 kHz 16-bit mono

voice._comment: Spoken words (24 Nov 2026): one clip per word and language at <folder>/<lang>/<file>.ogg, where <file> is sound.gd voice_file(key). 'enabled' is the master switch: while false, sound.gd say_word() plays nothing. Switched on 24 Nov 2026 (user). tools/voice_manifest.gd lists what to say; tools/voice_generate.py makes the clips with Amazon Polly. 'languages' gives each language's Polly voice. Guide: docs/guides/VOICE.md.
voice.source: Amazon Polly text-to-speech (neural engine), made by tools/voice_generate.py
voice.licence: Polly output, used under the AWS Service Terms; no third-party recordings

es.note: Latin American (Mexican) Spanish, user decision 24 Nov 2026, matching words.json's Mexican Spanish; samples approved by the user 24 Nov 2026. Male alternative: Andrés.

zh.note: Mandarin, like the game's pinyin. The Traditional text is spoken with the game's own pinyin (data/pinyin_zh.json) as SSML phonemes, so Polly does not guess readings.
